summary: Implement a customizable technical indicator strategy backtest system: MA/MACD/KDJ/BOLL indicator engine, cross_over/cross_under/gt/lt/and/or rule DSL, T+1 backtest engine with single-position long-only model, full backend stack (models/repo/service/API), and frontend page with config form, equity curve chart, and trade table. 9 tasks split across Codex (backend T1-T6) and Gemini (frontend T7-T9).
approach: Layered architecture mirroring existing backtest module with new strategy_backtest namespace. Backend-first execution enabling parallel frontend work. Engine -> Service -> Repository -> API layered separation. Pure-function indicator and rule engines for testability. Frontend follows existing BacktestPage patterns with Tailwind dark theme.

data_flow.diagram: DataFetcherManager -> DataFrame -> IndicatorEngine -> EnrichedDataFrame -> RuleEngine -> Signals -> BacktestEngine -> Trades/Equity/Summary -> Repository -> API -> Frontend

transformations: Fetch missing data from external source

stages.output: DataFrame with indicator columns (ma_5, macd_dif, kdj_k, boll_upper, etc.)
BacktestResult (trades list, equity curve, summary stats)
UI (config form, metric cards, equity chart, trade table)

design_decisions.decision: Independent module separate from existing AI backtest
design_decisions.rationale: Different semantic model: strategy rule execution vs AI suggestion evaluation. Separate tables and code prevent confusion and maintain backward compatibility.
design_decisions.tradeoff: Some code pattern duplication with existing backtest module

design_decisions.decision: Pure-function indicator and rule engines (no state, no DB)
design_decisions.rationale: Maximum testability with synthetic data, no external dependencies in core logic, easy to reason about correctness.
design_decisions.tradeoff: Service layer must orchestrate data flow, slightly more wiring code

design_decisions.decision: T+1 execution model (signal day T, execution day T+1 at open price)
design_decisions.rationale: Avoids look-ahead bias, matches realistic trading simulation, simple to understand and debug.
design_decisions.tradeoff: Cannot model intraday execution or T+0 scenarios in MVP

design_decisions.decision: Custom rule DSL with 6 operators instead of natural language
design_decisions.rationale: Deterministic evaluation, no LLM instability for rule interpretation, covers all PRD requirements.
design_decisions.tradeoff: Users must learn DSL syntax, no natural language input in MVP

design_decisions.decision: Backend assigned to Codex, Frontend assigned to Gemini
design_decisions.rationale: Parallel execution by specialized tools. Backend tasks are self-contained with clear interfaces. Frontend can start once API contract is defined.
design_decisions.tradeoff: Requires clear API contract upfront, coordination on schema changes

design_decisions.rationale: Consistent with existing project convention. Tables created on app startup.
design_decisions.tradeoff: No schema migration support, but acceptable for new feature with no existing data
